imageGeneration.prompt: Improve reference1 for EXACT full dealer name THE DEALERS POINT, all three words on ONE row. Keep the distinctive joined DP monogram with red directional point at left, open P/D gaps, compact. Make the full name larger and expressive using confident custom slightly forward-slanted moderately condensed automotive lettering with softened square curves and decisive angled cuts, not ultra-narrow upright type, not plain sans. Preserve graphite #25272c name/DP and deep red #bd0025 point accent. Do not remove THE or shorten DEALERS POINT; do not introduce apostrophe. Use reference2 only as the style anchor for confident custom automotive letters and compact one-row composition; do not copy its name, monogram, blue color or exact mark. The owner wants expressive, slightly forward-slanted, sculpted motorsport lettering with purposeful chamfers and softened corners, not a plain upright system sans serif. ONE NAME ROW ONLY: no line beneath, captions, slogans, descriptors or facts. Emblem to left at approximately letter cap height, fully separate from the name and at most18percent of logo width. Main name large and readable at120px. Preserve exact name and meaningful individual identity. Flat clean ink, restrained color, crisp open counters/negative spaces, complete unclipped true RGBA transparency including all counters. No opaque panel/plaque/background, checkerboard, shadow, halo, shiny texture or hairline ornaments. Modest transparent margins. This is a separate redesigned PROPOSAL awaiting owner/dealer style selection; original reference remains historical.
